sentences.cn_text: 成绩膨胀——即过去几十年间平均绩点（GPA）的逐步提高——通常被视为高等教育消费时代的产物，在这一时代，学生被当作需要取悦的客户对待。
sentences.en_text: Grade inflation — the gradual increase in average GPAs (grade-point averages) over the past few decades — is often considered a product of a consumer era in higher education, in which students are treated like customers to be pleased.

sentences.cn_text: 但另一股相关力量——一项通常深埋于课程目录中、名为「成绩宽恕」的政策——也在助推绩点提高。
sentences.en_text: But another, related force — a policy often buried deep in course catalogs called “grade forgiveness” is helping raise GPAs.

sentences.cn_text: 成绩宽恕允许学生重修获得低分的课程，而最近一次成绩或最高成绩是计入学生总体绩点的唯一成绩。
sentences.en_text: Grade forgiveness allows students to retake a course in which they received a low grade, and the most recent grade or the highest grade is the only one that counts in calculating a student’s overall GPA.

sentences.cn_text: 近年来，随着高校继续竭尽全力挽留学生（并收取学费）以及提高毕业率，这种鲜为人知的做法使用速度加快。
sentences.en_text: The use of this little-known practice has accelerated in recent years, as colleges continue to do their utmost to keep students in school (and paying tuition) and improve their graduation rates.

sentences.cn_text: 这一做法几十年前首次实施时，通常仅限于大一新生，目的是让他们在适应大学课程过程中遇到困难时，有第二次机会在第一学年重修课程。
sentences.en_text: When this practice first started decades ago, it was usually limited to freshmen, to give them a second chance to take a class in their first year if they struggled in their transition to college-level courses.

sentences.cn_text: 但如今，除少数录取门槛较高的院校外，大多数高校允许所有本科生、甚至研究生享受成绩宽恕政策。
sentences.en_text: But now most colleges, save for many selective campuses, allow all undergraduates, and even graduate students, to get their low grades forgiven.

sentences.cn_text: 高校官员也倾向于强调，成绩宽恕的目标与其说在于成绩本身，不如说在于鼓励学生重修对其学位项目和毕业至关重要的课程，而不必承受重大惩罚。
sentences.en_text: College officials also tend to emphasize that the goal of grade forgiveness is less about the grade itself and more about encouraging students to retake courses critical to their degree program and graduation without incurring a big penalty.

sentences.cn_text: 俄亥俄州立大学教务长杰克·迈纳表示：「最终，我们看到学生取得了更大的成功，因为他们重修课程后，在后续课程中表现更好，或掌握了能够使其按时毕业的内容。」
sentences.en_text: “Ultimately,” said Jack Miner, Ohio State University’s registrar, “we see students achieve more success because they retake a course and do better in subsequent courses or master the content that allows them to graduate on time.”

sentences.cn_text: 话虽如此，成绩宽恕在某种程度上也满足了高校自身的需求。
sentences.en_text: That said, there is a way in which grade forgiveness satisfies colleges’ own needs as well.

sentences.cn_text: 对于公立院校而言，州政府拨款有时部分取决于其在毕业率和学生保留率等指标上的表现——因此更高的成绩可以通过提升这些数字而带来更多资金。
sentences.en_text: For public institutions, state funds are sometimes tied partly to their success on metrics such as graduation rates and student retention — so better grades can, by boosting figures like those, mean more money.

sentences.cn_text: 任何提高绩点的做法都可能让学生——归根结底是付费方——觉得学费物有所值，而这也是高校的另一重大关切。
sentences.en_text: And anything that raises GPAs will likely make students — who, at the end of the day, are paying the bill — feel they’ve gotten a better value for their tuition dollars, which is another big concern for colleges.

sentences.cn_text: 实际上，成绩宽恕只是高校回应消费者对高等教育期望的又一方式。
sentences.en_text: Indeed, grade forgiveness is just another way that universities are responding to consumers’ expectations for higher education.

sentences.cn_text: 既然学生和家长期望大学学位能带来就业机会，那么培养尽可能合格的毕业生——或至少让他们看起来合格——就符合学校的最大利益。
sentences.en_text: Since students and parents expect a colleges degree to lead to a job, it is in the best interest of a school to turn out graduates who are as qualified as possible — or at least appear to be.

sentences.cn_text: 在这一点上，学生与高校的利益诉求似乎是一致的。
sentences.en_text: On this, students’ and colleges’ incentives seem to be aligned.

sentences.cn_text: 什么被普遍视为成绩膨胀的原因？
sentences.en_text: What is commonly regarded as the cause of grade inflation?

sentences.cn_text: 课程目录的改变。

sentences.cn_text: 消费文化的影响。
sentences.en_text: The influence of consumer culture.

sentences.cn_text: 成绩宽恕的最初目的是什么？
sentences.en_text: What was the original purpose of grade forgiveness?

sentences.cn_text: 帮助新生适应大学学习。
sentences.en_text: To help freshmen adapt to college learning.

sentences.cn_text: 维持高校的毕业率。
sentences.en_text: To maintain colleges’ graduation rates.

sentences.cn_text: 为毕业生应对充满挑战的未来做准备。
sentences.en_text: To prepare graduates for a challenging future.

sentences.cn_text: 增加高校的学费收入。
sentences.en_text: To increase universities’ income from tuition.

sentences.en_text: meet local governments’ needs.

sentences.en_text: The author examines the practice of grade forgiveness by ______
